fields.completionTextHint: Shown for one minute after the target; leave blank to hide at zero.
fields.showConfetti: Show confetti when the countdown reaches zero
fields.oneTimeAtHint: Entered in this browser's local time; the Player counts down to the same instant.
fields.progressFillHint: Drain empties the bar from right to left as the target approaches.
fields.paddingHint: Lower padding gives the message and countdown more room.
fields.textScaleHint: Increase the type size without changing the bar height.
fields.fontHint: Add fonts in Settings. Screens that cannot load the font keep the default.
fields.urgencyHint: Change the bar automatically as the target approaches. Untouched stage times follow the total lead time; custom values stay fixed. Completed messages return to the normal size.
fields.pulseHint: The bar and text grow by 25% during this final stage.
